text: Claude review of core successor fe45550 (tree 3057fd92; SQL/migrations byte-identical to 5df6e4b). Full doc: claude/xenios-health-launch-review-20260930 @ e6fa1f5, 20_REVIEW_fe45550_PAYMENT_AUTHORITY_ADDENDUM.md; probe sql/composed/sql01_auth01_probe.sql. F1-F10 unchanged, all OPEN (F1/F2 P1). Protected files: PASS on review, owner repin still pending. Payment/early-access tests at fe45550 on Node 20.19.0 single worker: 163 files, 2540 pass, 25 skip, 0 fail. NEW EXECUTED P1 HL12-SQL-01: as service_role with 0 verifier grants, payment_observe(R,Q,'provider',10000,'USD','pi_forged','x',now(),null,'anything','evt_forged','pi_forged') then payment_verify_bound(R,obs,null) returns state paid and the request is paid. provider-adapter.ts does not close it (no SQL attempt/event authority). Fix: make payment_observe refuse p_method='provider' now with a stable P0001 detail (e.g. PROVIDER_AUTHORITY_NOT_READY); later require a server-created attempt row (request, quote, version, acceptance, amount, currency, provider, account, mode, unique payment id), captured-only; correct the 202413:1-3 header (the hold is replaced, not in force); prove under SET ROLE service_role. NEW EXECUTED P2 AUTH-01: quote_accept on a guest request (actor_member_id NULL) with an unrelated member id, no session/token, returns an acceptanceId and the quote is accepted; wrong-session control is refused. 202413:385-392 uses if not v_authorized (true and NULL = NULL). Fix: if v_authorized is not true then return null; add NULL-owner and NULL-session proofs. HTTP is gated only by finance.ts:149 calling getQuote first. SOURCE-VERIFIED, not sent before: HIST-02 P2 payment_pending/payment_review rows can never be quoted (quote_issue 269-274), and no accepted quote is required before payment_pending; SQL-06 P2 no UPDATE/DELETE immutability trigger on quotes; SQL-09 P2 no quantity<=0 floor in quote_issue; SQL-03b P2 currency not normalized at observe (upper/btrim plus ^[A-Z]{3}$, compare to the quote before consuming the reference); SQL-02b P2 observe accepted on cancelled/closed; CANC-01 P2 map every M82 detail to 409 and refuse supplier_processing->cancelled in the service/UI; SQL-08 P2 store observer/verifier auth UUIDs, append-only grants, idempotency key; ROLL-01/02/03 P2 real rollback runbook (flag off, preflight counts, roll back only by re-applying the M81 hold body, never drop financial rows), M82 preflight asserts the M81 trigger, exact-SHA app-first rollout doc; P3: verify_bound NULL request id (use is distinct from), M83 begin/commit+preflight, raise detail codes and on-conflict replay, accept status check, withdraw path, DAG CLI enumerates migrations, proofs under service_role with specific SQLSTATEs. ADAPTER c042599 is processor-neutral and fine as a contract; before mounting: ADP-01 P2 authenticated but unbound or wrong-amount events are discarded with no durable record (authenticate first, resolve the attempt from the authenticated id, quarantine durably), ADP-02 P3 retrieve cannot report captured. fe45550 EA-01 P2: the open-access mint limiter never evicts an active key, so at 10,000 IPs with 1 mint each every new visitor is refused for up to 15 min (the old policy evicted non-locked entries); evict the oldest key below maxMints and refuse only when all are exhausted; adjust open-access-window.test.ts:72. NEXT CORRECTION ORDER: SQL-01 fail-closed + AUTH-01 (small SQL forward migration), F2, F10, CANC-01/F8 mapping, F4, F3/F5/F6 with SQL-03b/SQL-02b, F7, rollout/rollback/preflight docs, then F1 evidence authority.
